# Markup-guided forest-green armchair edit

[← Back to all cases](../../README.md#all-cases)

<a href="README.md"><img src="../../assets/badges/language-en-current.svg" alt="Current language: English" height="34" /></a> <a href="README.zh-CN.md"><img src="../../assets/badges/language-zh-CN.svg" alt="View translation: 简体中文" height="34" /></a>

**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

The 2048×1365 marked input and 1536×1024 output are archived separately. The main upholstery becomes green and the cushion remains white, but the chair’s lower foreground support becomes a broad green extension instead of preserving the original leg boundary. This is a useful edit example with a visible preservation error, not a perfect surgical edit.
